sloka: ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो रामं वचनमब्रुवन् ।गच्छन्तमनुगच्छामो यत्र राम गमिष्यसि ।। ७.१०७.१२ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo rāmaṁ vacanamabruvan ।gacchantamanugacchāmo yatra rāma gamiṣyasi ।। 7.107.12 ॥

translations.english: Then all the subjects spoke to Rama, saying, "We will follow you, wherever you, Rama, will go."
